long_biography.plain_text:
Holterman's recommendation that Reggeborgh invest in internet provider World Online established his reputation as a Dutch dealmaker. He represented Reggeborgh on the company's supervisory board and shared in the investment's value through a minority stake in the family investment group.

After twelve demanding years, Holterman sold that stake and formed Orbys to invest independently. He described his earlier partnership with Dik Wessels as a two-step discipline: Holterman found prospective deals, while Wessels acted as the final filter. Holterman later returned to Reggeborgh and again took a leading role in allocating the Wessels family's capital. His tenure has favoured long-term positions and active involvement in portfolio companies rather than a fixed concentration on one industry.
